messages.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
messages.text: Android D1 for last week's cohorts is down to ~30% from ~36%. iOS looks fine. My guess is Android traffic quality from the networks is getting worse: AppLovin and Meta both pushed more Android inventory recently. Proposal: cut Android bids 15% on Meta, AppLovin and TikTok until it recovers.

replies.author: Priya Raman
replies.text: Possible. Meta did tell us they're expanding automatic placements on Android. But CPI hasn't moved at all, which is weird if we're buying worse traffic.

replies.author: Daniel Esposito
replies.text: Same on AppLovin, CPI and CTR flat. If it were bad traffic I'd expect CTR or CVR to move.

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: Fair point. Let's not touch bids until Ingrid has looked at it by channel.

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: Correction to the traffic-quality theory (details in #data-questions): the Android D1 drop is the same size in *every* channel, including Organic (41.5% -> 34.0%). It starts sharply with the 2026-07-22 install cohort. iOS is flat. Organic users don't come from ad networks, so this can't be traffic quality. It lines up with Android app release 2.14.0, which went to 100% on the evening of Jul 21.

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: That settles it, I was wrong. No bid cuts. Escalating to product. Thanks Ingrid :bow:

replies.author: Felix Brandt
replies.text: Product here. 2.14.0 shipped the new first-session tutorial and a new asset-bundle loader. Looking at crash/ANR and tutorial funnel now.
